questions.step3Question: What do you want right now, at this stage of your life?
questions.step3Hint: Your goal should be measurable, something you can count: money, weight, number of clients. For example, “200,000 ₸ a month”.

questions.step7Hint: Choose a step above your “I” point
questions.step9AnswerHint: One or two words are enough.
